provenance.selection: Class-balanced label coverage; stable photographer group assignment; all previous samples keep their split

provenance.correction: Corrected README display-order assumption to authoritative YOLO numeric class IDs before usable training; sh17-g1 aborted and preserved

provenance.evaluation_change: Expanded development holdouts; compare parent and child on this identical dataset, not old test scores

fire_expansion.interpretation: Only fire received additional images in g4b. Data, focal loss, batch size and training device changed together; focal effect is not isolated.
